Jenny — thanks for sending these over. A couple of items for the vendor master record so our AP team can process POs and payments without delays: 

1) Please confirm the full legal entity exactly as it should appear on contracts and the vendor master (you listed "Rivermark, Inc."). Is that the correct, complete registered name?
2) Can you provide the tax classification (C corp / S corp / LLC single-member / other) for 1099 purposes?
3) Confirm the remit bank details (routing + acct) or confirm ACH instructions can be provided via secure upload.
4) Which address should appear on the invoice's "Bill to" line vs. "Remit to" (you included both; tell us which to use for PO vs payment).
5) Point of contact for billing disputes (name, phone).
6) Do you accept Redwood POs with invoice reference prefix RVM- (we typically require PO number on invoices)?

I've attached our vendor_master_template_Redwood.xlsx — if you can fill and return that it will speed setup. Once we have the completed template + W-9 + incorporation cert, we'll route the record to Finance for validation. 

Marissa — looping you to keep CS/Onboarding aware in case any provisioning depends on PO issuance.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
